crimsondesert.label: Recommended

crimsondesert.label: Flame Hue Correction
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Corrects pink/red flame and torch colors toward warm orange/yellow.
Uses MacLeod-Boynton chromaticity rotation in Stockman-Sharp LMS.
0 = no correction (vanilla pink/red), 100 = full warm fire hue.

crimsondesert.label: Flame Saturation
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Adjusts saturation of local light sources (fire, torches, braziers).
Controls MacLeod-Boynton purity distance from achromatic axis.
0 = fully desaturated, 50 = unchanged, 100 = maximum saturation.

crimsondesert.label: Alternative Auto Exposure was made with HDR output + max settings + RR in mind (other settings may result in overly dark or blown out scenes). It fixes nuclear highlight issues whilst also making night scenes actually dark
Auto Exposure
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Enables control over the brightness of dark and bright scenes.
Custom provides control over dark and bright scene brightness, anchored in vanilla behavior.
Custom Perceptual uses a more advanced system that attempts to emulate the human eye.

crimsondesert.label: Low Light Exposure Limit
crimsondesert.tooltip: Adjusts the max exposure value that can be applied, controlling how dark the game is allowed to get.

crimsondesert.label: Auto Exposure Darkness
crimsondesert.tooltip: Controls brightness level of dark scenes. 50 = neutral

crimsondesert.label: Auto Exposure Brightness
crimsondesert.tooltip: Controls brightness level of bright scenes. 50 = neutral

crimsondesert.label: Adaptation Speed
crimsondesert.tooltip: Controls the speed of Custom auto exposure adaptation. 0 = Vanilla speed

crimsondesert.label: Minimum Brightness
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Minimum brightness bound for Perceptual.
Values are percentages of diffuse white.
0 = no minimum bound.
With both min and max at 0, Perceptual targets its adapted field directly.

crimsondesert.label: Maximum Brightness
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Maximum brightness bound for Perceptual.
Values are percentages of diffuse white.
0 = no maximum bound.
With both min and max at 0, Perceptual targets its adapted field directly.

crimsondesert.label: Short-Term Adaptation
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls the short adaptation time constant in Perceptual.
Used directly for brightening, and as the fast branch for darkening before bleaching becomes significant.
Lower values react faster to short scene changes.
Higher values reduce snapping and transient flicker.

crimsondesert.label: Long-Term Adaptation
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls the slow dark-adaptation time constant in Perceptual.
The actual darkening rate blends from Short-Term Adaptation toward this value using the Rushton-Henry bleached fraction of the previous adaptation state.
Lower values settle to the new scene sooner.
Higher values preserve longer recovery only after very bright preadaptation.

crimsondesert.label: Environment Bias
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls how strongly Perceptual keeps the game's raw-meter clamp pair.
AE2 now solves exposure from its own perceptual field; the old sky-visibility placement curve no longer drives the live AE2 exposure solve.
0 = ignore the game's clamp pair.
100 = use the full game clamp pair on the raw meter.

crimsondesert.label: Metering Delay
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Smooths measured scene brightness before auto exposure reacts.
Values are in milliseconds.
0 = off.
Higher values reduce pulsing but make the meter react more slowly.

crimsondesert.label: Dark Power (Indoor)
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls how aggressively auto exposure compensates for dark indoor scenes.
Lower = less brightening of dark areas.

crimsondesert.label: Bright Power (Outdoor)
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls how aggressively auto exposure compensates for bright outdoor scenes.
Lower = less dimming of bright areas.

crimsondesert.label: Bright Power (Indoor)
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Controls how aggressively auto exposure compensates for bright indoor scenes.
Lower = less dimming of bright areas.

crimsondesert.label: Adaptation Speed Boost
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Multiplier for temporal adaptation speed.
Higher = faster eye adaptation.

crimsondesert.label: EV Bias
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Exposure Value bias applied to the final exposure output.
Negative = darker, Positive = brighter.

crimsondesert.label: Min Luminance
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Minimum luminance clamp (overrides per region/ToD values).
Slider value is multiplied by 0.001.

crimsondesert.label: Max Luminance
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Maximum luminance clamp (overrides per region/ToD values).
Slider value is multiplied by 0.1.

Vanilla = AWB enabled (can cause hue shifts in HDR).
Disable AWB = AWB disabled, hero/fill lights remain.
Disable AWB + Hero Lights = AWB and hero/fill lights disabled.

Spectral Sky Scattering
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Toggles Spectral rendering atmospheric scattering.

crimsondesert.label: Sun Improvements + Moon Adjustments
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Improves Sun and applies a 10x brightness reduction to the moon disk.
Off = vanilla (Default shimmery sun blob + moon uses sun scale luminance, clips to white ball).
On = Physically based sun additions + moon luminance reduced to reveal texture detail.

crimsondesert.label: Dawn/Dusk Improvements (WIP)
crimsondesert.tooltip: Directionality additions to atmospheric lighting at dawn and dusk.

crimsondesert.label: Snow Fog Scattering Fix (WIP)
crimsondesert.tooltip: Fixes massive brightness swings for both the sky and GI in snowy regions with heavy fog especially.

crimsondesert.label: Moon Disk Size
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Scales the angular size of the moon disk.
1 = vanilla size. 10 = 10x larger.

crimsondesert.label: Grass/Foliage Improvements (WIP)
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Toggles contact shadow changes + transmission + AO.
Off = vanilla foliage.
On = improved foliage/grass shadow detail with tighter depth bias and higher opacity to stop abyss occluder shadows for foliage.
Transmission has been added to simulate diffuse scattering through vegetation / base game was completely uniform.
Added shader side simple AO for foliage since the base game lacks it entirely, causing uniform foliage

crimsondesert.label: Material Improvements
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Enables all material/lighting improvements:
- EON 2025 energy-preserving diffuse BRDF
- Callisto smooth terminator
- Geometric specular anti aliasing
- Spectral diffraction on metals

crimsondesert.label: THIS SECTION IS EXTREMELY WIP, ATM IT IS JUST SOME RT TWEAKS WE HAVE BEEN EXPERIMENTING WITH. THERE IS A LOT OF NOISE SO ONLY USABLE FOR SCREENSHOTS
WARNING: PATCH 1.02.00 HAS REDUCED GI QUALITY TO HALF RES AND ALSO DID OTHER CHANGES, SPMIS LOOKS SIGNIFICANTLY WORSE IN EXTERIORS, ONLY USE FOR INTERIOR SCREENSHOTS WITH REDUCED AUTO EXPOSURE
Raytracing Improvements
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Toggles RenoDX raytracing noise improvements.
Off = vanilla white noise (TEA+MCG) for all RT sampling.
SPMIS = R2 blue noise + Stochastic Pairwise MIS spatial resampling.
Debug Noise = visualizes the raw noise texture sample as colour output.

crimsondesert.label: Shadow Debug View
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Visualizes internal shadow layer data. Replaces the shadow buffer output with a diagnostic color.
Off = normal rendering.
Terrain Shadow = grey: dark=shadowed, white=lit.
Dynamic Cascade = cyan=cascade0, yellow=cascade1, dark-red=not covered.
Static Cascade = green=static0, blue=static1, dark-red=not covered.
Active Layer Map = false-color which cascade layer is active per pixel.
Pre-Contact PCF = combined shadow after cascades/near-field, before contact shadows.
Contact Shadow = dark=occluded by screen-space contact shadow.
Depth Delta = heatmap of depth-behind-shadowmap (bias diagnosis).
Penumbra Channel = raw W-channel (gamma-stretched depth advance).
Stencil ID = false-color by material stencil group.
Cascade Seams = yellow highlight at dynamic cascade UV boundaries.

crimsondesert.label: Shadow Layer Disable
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Disables a specific shadow layer so you can see its contribution by toggling it off.
None = all layers active (normal rendering).
Terrain Shadow = heightmap PCF.
Dynamic Cascade = character/object cascade shadow maps.
Static Cascade = baked environment cascade shadow maps.
Near-Field Contact = ray-marched near-field contact shadows.
Screen-Space Contact = screen-space contact shadow pass.

crimsondesert.label: Tonemap Debug
crimsondesert.tooltip:
Diagnostic overlay for the Crimson Desert tonemap passes.
Off = normal rendering.
Graph = RenoDX graph through HDR/SDR tonemapping.
Stats = HDR canvas panel with perceptual AE anchors.
Both = graph and stats together.

An offset to apply to the black floor value in the LUT shader. 
The final value will not go negative so you can set this to the minimum value to ensure the black floor is never raised.
Unfortunately, the parameter is often used to raise the overall brightness in darker scenes, so you might end up darkening the game too much at times.
The game often uses around 0.02 to slightly raise the brightness, so something like -0.02 is a rather safe conservative value to use.

falcomengine-plus.label: IS-FAST Noise
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Master toggle for IS-FAST spatio-temporal blue noise. Requires fast_noise_ea.dds next to game .exe.

falcomengine-plus.label: Noise Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: 0 = deterministic (banding), 1 = full noise.

falcomengine-plus.label: Debug Logging
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Log IS-FAST texture load status and noise source.

falcomengine-plus.label: Spatial Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scale noise spatial frequency. <1 zooms in (smoother), >1 adds more detail.

falcomengine-plus.label: Temporal Speed
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scale noise animation speed. 0 = frozen, 1 = default, 5 = fast flicker.

falcomengine-plus.label: Seed Offset
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Offset the noise seed pattern (0-64). Shift to find optimal noise distribution.

falcomengine-plus.label: Lighting Mip Boost
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Lighting shader cubemap mip scale. Default is 1.5x.

falcomengine-plus.label: Color Boost
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales SSGI RGB contribution before power shaping.

falcomengine-plus.label: Alpha Boost
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales SSGI alpha before saturate.

falcomengine-plus.label: Power
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Applies pow(abs(color), Power) to shape bounce response.

falcomengine-plus.label: Mode
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vanilla keeps the original blur shader. Improved uses DOF method 3 (gather).

falcomengine-plus.label: Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Overall blend strength for improved DOF output.

falcomengine-plus.label: Radius Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales blur radius derived from game CoC.

falcomengine-plus.label: Sample Count
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Higher values produce smoother bokeh at higher cost.

falcomengine-plus.label: Near Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales near-field CoC response.

falcomengine-plus.label: Far Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales far-field CoC response.

falcomengine-plus.label: CoC Curve
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Applies pow(CoC, Curve) before blur; >1 tightens focus transition.

falcomengine-plus.label: Edge Threshold
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Rejects CoC-mismatched taps to reduce foreground/background bleeding.

falcomengine-plus.label: Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Overall contribution scale for character GI.

falcomengine-plus.label: Alpha Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales sampled SSGI alpha before blending.

falcomengine-plus.label: Chroma
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales colorful GI component; lower values reduce tinting.

falcomengine-plus.label: Luma
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales neutral GI brightness; keep low to avoid white haze.

falcomengine-plus.label: Shadow Power
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Higher values concentrate GI toward darker areas.

falcomengine-plus.label: Dark Boost
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Extra GI multiplier in darker regions (after shadow mask).

falcomengine-plus.label: Bright Boost
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Boosts GI on brighter regions (values above 1.0 increase bright-side contribution).

falcomengine-plus.label: Headroom Power
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Controls how strongly bright pixels reject additional GI.

falcomengine-plus.label: Max Add
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Per-channel cap for added GI to prevent haze/bloomy washout.

falcomengine-plus.label: Peak Luma Cap
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Caps peak GI brightness on characters after blending weights. Set 0 to disable.

falcomengine-plus.label: Depth Reject
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Higher values suppress GI across depth discontinuities and silhouette edges.

falcomengine-plus.label: Fog Min Chroma
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Minimum chroma ratio applied during fog hue/chroma restoration.

falcomengine-plus.label: Fog Max Chroma
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Maximum chroma ratio applied during fog hue/chroma restoration.

falcomengine-plus.label: Fog Lightness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scales fog lightness restoration amount.

falcomengine-plus.label: 3D Fog Correction Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Controls how strongly fog color correction is applied to volumetric fog. 0 = off, 1 = full.

falcomengine-plus.label: Volumetric Haze AA
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Mode for volumetric haze anti-aliasing: Vanilla or Improved.

falcomengine-plus.label: Hard Shadow Samples
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Number of hard-contact samples at the start of the ray march. 0 = auto (Sample Count / 8). Higher = sharper contact shadows, but may miss thin occluders.

falcomengine-plus.label: Fade Out Samples
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Number of fade-out samples at the end of the ray march. 0 = auto (Sample Count / 3). Higher = smoother transition from shadow to no shadow, reducing banding in soft shadows.

falcomengine-plus.label: CSM Indoor Gate
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Skip screen-space shadows on pixels already in deep CSM shadow (prevents false shadows inside buildings).

falcomengine-plus.label: Local SSS
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Enable Bend_SSS screen-space ray-march shadows for point/spot lights.

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Type
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Which light types receive screen-space shadows.

falcomengine-plus.label: Hard Samples
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Number of hard-contact samples at the start. 0 = auto (Sample Count / 8).

falcomengine-plus.label: Fade Samples
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Number of fade-out samples at the end. 0 = auto (Sample Count / 3).

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Fade Start
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Screen-distance where shadow starts fading (0 = at the light, 1 = at light radius edge).

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Fade End
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Screen-distance where shadow is fully faded out.

falcomengine-plus.label: Occluder Depth Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scale minimum occluder depth for thin geometry. Higher = wider occluders, fewer false shadows.

falcomengine-plus.label: GTVBAO mode
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Off = vanilla game AO. On = GTVBAO compute-shader AO.

falcomengine-plus.label: Jitter
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Enable temporal jitter even when denoising is off.

falcomengine-plus.label: Noise Type
falcomengine-plus.tooltip:
IS-FAST = pre-computed blue noise (needs fast_noise_ea.dds). "
                 "IGN = Interleaved Gradient Noise. Hilbert = Hilbert curve noise. "
                 "Only applies when IS-FAST master toggle is On; forced to Hilbert when Off.

falcomengine-plus.label: Bitmask Thickness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: World-space thickness for visibility bitmask. Higher = more light passes behind surfaces.

falcomengine-plus.label: GTVBAO CDF Remap
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: CDF-remap horizon angles to correct sample density near the view pole. Reduces AO bias.

falcomengine-plus.label: GTVBAO Cosine Sampling
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Sample slice directions from a cosine-weighted hemisphere instead of uniformly. Physically correct AO falloff.

falcomengine-plus.label: Cosine Sampling Mode
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Mode 1: Uniform slices with per-slice weight. Mode 2: Ray projection from world-space lobe. Mode 3: CDF importance sampling (best quality/speed).

falcomengine-plus.label: GTVBAO Per-Sample Thickness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Compute thickness offset per sample direction instead of using fixed view-vector offset. Correct for wide FOV.

falcomengine-plus.label: Denoiser Type
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Spatial: 5x5 edge-aware blur only. Spatio-Temporal: blends with previous frame for much higher stability on thin geometry. Poisson: disk sampling with luma/depth/normal similarity weights.

falcomengine-plus.label: Poisson Samples
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Number of Poisson disk samples for denoising. More samples = better quality, higher cost.

falcomengine-plus.label: Poisson Luma Phi
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Luma/AO similarity falloff. Lower = stricter (only very similar pixels contribute). Higher = more blur.

falcomengine-plus.label: Poisson Depth Phi
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Depth similarity falloff. Lower = stricter (only coplanar surfaces contribute). Higher = more blur across depth edges.

falcomengine-plus.label: Poisson Normal Phi
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Normal similarity falloff (exponent). Lower = stricter (only same-facing surfaces). Higher = more blur across normals.

falcomengine-plus.label: Temporal Frames
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How many previous frames influence the result. 0-1 = off (spatial only). 2 = fast response. 8 = balanced (default). 16 = most stable, some ghosting.

falcomengine-plus.label: Disocclusion Threshold
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Max depth difference to accept history sample. Higher = more ghosting, less flicker on disocclusion.

falcomengine-plus.label: MRT Normal Input
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Off = depth normals only. On = use game g-buffer normals.

falcomengine-plus.label: Normal Transform Mode
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How to transform MRT normals to view space. Try alternatives if normals look wrong at some camera angles.

falcomengine-plus.label: Fix Experimental
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Bitmask AO experimental fixes. 0=Off (baseline). Test each mode to diagnose darkening.

falcomengine-plus.label: Frame Skip
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Skip GTVBAO AO+GI computation every N frames to improve performance.

falcomengine-plus.label: Pre-filter AO
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Depth-aware 3×3 bilateral pre-filter on raw AO before power curve (reduces bitmask noise).

falcomengine-plus.label: Exclude Foliage
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Skip AO computation on foliage pixels (prevent wind disocclusion noise).

falcomengine-plus.label: Grass AO
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Per-blade vertical AO gradient: dark at root, bright at tip. Replaces noisy SSAO/GTAO on foliage with a stable bake. (Ghost of Tsushima §1.5e-ii)

falcomengine-plus.label: Grass AO Base
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: AO multiplier at the blade root. Lower = darker base (more self-occlusion).

falcomengine-plus.label: Grass AO Tip
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: AO multiplier at the blade tip. Values > 1.0 slightly brighten the tip (rim-light effect).

falcomengine-plus.label: Hammon 2017 Diffuse
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Replaces Lambert diffuse with Hammon 2017 GGX+Smith multi-scatter energy-conserving diffuse (GDC 2017).

falcomengine-plus.label: Diffuse Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend between vanilla Lambert and Hammon diffuse. 0=vanilla, 1=full Hammon, 2=2x boost.

falcomengine-plus.label: Multi-Scatter GGX Specular
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Replaces Blinn-Phong specular with GGX D·V·F + Kulla-Conty multi-scatter compensation (SIGGRAPH 2017).

falcomengine-plus.label: Specular Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend between vanilla Blinn-Phong and GGX+multi-scatter specular. 0=vanilla, 1=full GGX+MS, 2=2x boost.

falcomengine-plus.label: Roughness Min
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Clamp minimum perceptual roughness to prevent GGX singularity. 0.04 is a safe minimum for most materials.

falcomengine-plus.label: CS Dispatch Fix
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Fixes double volumetrics caused by stale compute descriptor bindings. Fix 1: restore state via Apply(). Fix 2: null compute descriptors. Fix 3: null + restore.

falcomengine-plus.label: VBGI Enable
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Visibility bitmask indirect diffuse GI. Requires GTVBAO mode = On.

falcomengine-plus.label: Saturation
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: 0 = grayscale GI, 1 = full color GI.

falcomengine-plus.label: Character Mask Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Reduce SSGI on character models. 0 = full GI on characters, 1 = fully masked.

falcomengine-plus.label: Multi-Bounce
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Enables multi-bounce GI: previous frame's indirect light feeds back into the GI computation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Multi-Bounce Saturation
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Color saturation of the multi-bounce feedback. 0 = grayscale, 1 = full color.

falcomengine-plus.label: Multi-Bounce Max Clamp
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Clamp multi-bounce feedback per-channel to prevent over-brightening. 0 = off.

falcomengine-plus.label: Red Adaptive Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Per-channel adaptive boost: amplifies a color channel more when it's dominant. 0=off, 1=max.

falcomengine-plus.label: Green Adaptive Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Per-channel adaptive boost: amplifies a color channel more when it's dominant. 0=off, 1=max.

falcomengine-plus.label: Blue Adaptive Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Per-channel adaptive boost: amplifies a color channel more when it's dominant. 0=off, 1=max.

falcomengine-plus.label: Adaptive Mode
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: GI Color = boost channels based on GI's own color. Albedo = boost based on surface color at pixel.

falcomengine-plus.label: Adaptive Luma Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Target brightness for GI normalization. 0=off. Higher = brighter target. Evens out indoor/outdoor GI.

falcomengine-plus.label: Adaptive Luma Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend between original GI (0) and luma-normalized GI (1).

falcomengine-plus.label: GI Max Clamp
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Clamp GI per-channel to this maximum. 0 = off.

falcomengine-plus.label: Reduce AO with GI
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Reduce GTVBAO occlusion where indirect light is strong. Keeps dark crevices dark while brightening lit surfaces.

falcomengine-plus.label: Reduce AO Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How strongly indirect light reduces AO. 0=no change, 1=full reduction.

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Exposure
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Exposure scale for HDR light buffer. Start at 0.05. Lower = dimmer GI.

falcomengine-plus.label: SSGI Frame Skip
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Skip GI computation every N frames. AO still runs every frame.

falcomengine-plus.label: Multi-Bounce Frame Skip
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Skip multi-bounce accumulation every N frames.

falcomengine-plus.label: VBGI debug View
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Replace scene with VBGI debug textures.

falcomengine-plus.label: VBGI debug Logging
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Log VBGI dispatch, push, and texture binding to console.

falcomengine-plus.label: Consume Falcom SSGI (Kai)
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: When ON, Falcom's SSGI color modulates GTVBAO VBGI before blending. Creates a multiplicative interaction between the two GI sources.

falcomengine-plus.label: Falcom SSGI Blend (Kai)
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How much Falcom SSGI color modulates GTVBAO VBGI. 0 = no modulation (additive only), 1 = full multiplicative blend.

falcomengine-plus.label: GTVBAO VBGI Only (Kai)
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: When ON, Falcom SSGI is suppressed from output and only GTVBAO VBGI is visible. GTVBAO can still consume Falcom SSGI internally for modulation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Affect Lights
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Additively blend the sun's lightColor into the GI contribution, tinting indirect light.

falcomengine-plus.label: Lights Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How much lightColor to add. 0=no effect, 1=full sun color, >1=boosted.

falcomengine-plus.label: Lights Saturation
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vibrance applied to lightColor before adding. 0=grayscale, 1=neutral, >1=vivid.

falcomengine-plus.label: CascadeCount Debug
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Color overlay by shadowmapCascadeCount_g: 0=red, 1=yellow, 2=green, 3=cyan, 4=blue.

falcomengine-plus.label: Deferred Dispatch
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Move GTVBAO/VBGI dispatch to OnPresent (1-frame latency). Kai-only, default ON — avoids CS binding contamination.

falcomengine-plus.label: Ensure Pipelines
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Don't destroy/recreate pipelines every frame (kai-style).

falcomengine-plus.label: Shadow Filter Method
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: CSM filtering: Off = single sample. Falcom = vanilla 10-tap PCF. PCSS = physically-accurate soft shadows.

falcomengine-plus.label: Colored Shadow Penumbra
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Off = neutral edges. Falcom = vanilla red tint. Improved = PCSS vibrancy boost in penumbra.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Jitter
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Use IS-FAST spatio-temporal noise to rotate PCSS sample pattern each frame.

falcomengine-plus.label: Jitter Amount
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: 0 = static Poisson, 1 = full temporal rotation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Jitter Speed
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Temporal animation speed. Higher = faster rotation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Base Softness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Constant minimum penumbra width. Contact-hard at 0, always soft at 0.5.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How fast penumbra widens with occluder distance. Higher = softer distant shadows.

falcomengine-plus.label: Filter Width
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: PCF filter width multiplier. Lower = sharper, higher = blurrier.

falcomengine-plus.label: Depth Sensitivity
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Max depth difference for penumbra. Higher = more distance-based softening.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Fix A: Texel-Based Softness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Override world-space filter with texel-based radius. Consistent softness across all quality levels.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Fix B: Clamp Cascade Size
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Cap the cascade world size. Prevents Ultra's extended cascades from collapsing the filter. 0=off.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Fix C: Minimum Filter Radius
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Guaranteed minimum PCF filter radius in shadow map texels. Prevents filter from collapsing. 0=off.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Fix D: Auto-Scale Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Scale cascade blend by split distance. Larger cascades get tighter blends. Off = static blend value.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Color Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: How strongly the vibrancy effect is applied in penumbra regions. 0=off, 1=full.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Vibrance
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vibrance adjustment in penumbra. 0=grayscale, 1=neutral, >1=more vivid. Protects already-saturated colors.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Detection
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: What counts as penumbra. Higher = wider detection area, more of the image gets the effect.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Color Brightness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Brightness multiplier for the vibrancy tint color. 1=neutral, 0=black, >1=brighter.

falcomengine-plus.label: Falcom Penumbra Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend the vibrancy effect toward Falcom's red shadowEdgeColor tint. 0=pure vibrancy, 1=pure Falcom.

falcomengine-plus.label: Edge Color Vibrance
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vibrance applied to shadowEdgeColor when Falcom blend > 0. 0=grayscale, 1=neutral, >1=vivid.

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Color Blend
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend the penumbra tint toward the sun's lightColor. 0=no effect, 1=fully sun-colored penumbra.

falcomengine-plus.label: Light Color Saturation
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vibrance applied to lightColor before blending. 0=grayscale, 1=neutral, >1=vivid sun color.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Debug View
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Visualize penumbra processing. PenumbraMask=detection area, TintColor=adjusted color, Result=final blend.

falcomengine-plus.label: Base Softness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Constant minimum penumbra width for PCSS shadows. 0 = contact-hard, higher = always soft.

falcomengine-plus.label: PCSS Jitter
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Use IS-FAST blue noise to rotate PCSS sample pattern each frame.

falcomengine-plus.label: Jitter Amount
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: 0 = static Poisson, 1 = full temporal rotation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Jitter Speed
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Temporal animation speed. Higher = faster rotation.

falcomengine-plus.label: Colored Penumbra
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Improved mode applies vibrance boost in shadow penumbra regions. No Falcom fallback on Kai.

falcomengine-plus.label: Hero Light Suppression
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Suppresses dynamic point/spot lights on character pixels. 0=off (vanilla), 1=fully remove.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Overall strength of the colored penumbra effect.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Vibrance
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Vibrance applied to surface color in penumbra. 0=grayscale, 1=neutral, >1=vivid.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Detection
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Penumbra detection width. Higher = wider area gets the effect.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Brightness
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Brightness multiplier for the penumbra tint color.

falcomengine-plus.label: Penumbra Debug
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Visualize penumbra: 0=Off, 1=Detection Mask, 2=Tint Color, 3=Result, 4=Sun Color.

falcomengine-plus.label: Enable
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Camera-motion blur post-process (Guertin et al. 2013).

falcomengine-plus.label: Sample Count
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Gather samples per pixel. Higher = smoother, more GPU cost. 25 matches the paper.

falcomengine-plus.label: Tile Size (px)
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Tile size in pixels. Paper default=40. Smaller = finer velocity detail, larger = broader blur.

falcomengine-plus.label: Velocity Scale
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Multiply motion vectors. >1 = more blur, <1 = less blur.

falcomengine-plus.label: Sample Spread
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Multiply sample distance along blur direction. >1 = longer motion streaks.

falcomengine-plus.label: Strength
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Blend original vs blurred. 0=off, 1=full.

falcomengine-plus.label: Noise Type
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Jitter noise source. Halton = deterministic, IS-FAST = blue noise (better at low samples).

falcomengine-plus.label: Half Resolution
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Run at half resolution for ~2x performance.

falcomengine-plus.label: Max Velocity (px)
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Soft-clamp velocity at this pixel value. 0=off. Prevents excessive character blur.

falcomengine-plus.label: Adaptive Sampling
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Use fewer samples for slow motion. Near-zero quality loss, ~40%% faster.

falcomengine-plus.label: Velocity Source
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Motion vector source. Game MV = per-object + camera vectors. Depth reprojection = camera-only vectors.

falcomengine-plus.label: Debug View
falcomengine-plus.tooltip: Visualize processed motion vectors. R=horizontal+, G=vertical+. Gray=static.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: GI Strength
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Scales composite GI contribution derived from ambient inputs.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Tint Saturation
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Controls saturation applied to the selected tint sources.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Shadow Influence
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: How much shadowing affects GI visibility.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Color Boost
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Boosts GI chroma (colorfulness) without boosting gray luma as much.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Bleed Radius
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Samples nearby albedo/AO to create visible color bleed.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Tint Blend
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Blends between Tint Source A (0) and B (100).

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Tint Luma Influence
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Lower values reduce grime-like luma transfer from albedo/spec textures.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Detail Suppression
ffxv-vanillaplus.tooltip: Suppresses high-frequency texture detail from tint sources.

ffxv-vanillaplus.label: Negative Clamp

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Anti-Aliasing
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Off: no anti-aliasing (FXAA replaced by a passthrough). FXAA: the game's original luma FXAA. DLAA: NVIDIA DLAA (requires nvngx_dlss.dll).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Jitter Report (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: DIAGNOSTIC: scales the NGX jitter offset reported to DLSS WITHOUT changing the rendered jitter. 'None' reports 0 (frames ARE still jittered) — if that looks identical to 1x, DLSS ignores the reported jitter entirely. 0.5x/2x test the magnitude.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Jitter In MV (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: ROOT-CAUSE FIX (diagnostic): the per-frame rendered jitter is NOT being compensated via the reported offset (Freeze Report = no change), so it reads as sub-pixel motion -> shimmer, worst at low FPS. The velocity shader bakes the jitter DELTA (current - previous frame) into the MVs, and the reported jitter is forced to 0 so DLSS does NOT double-count. This routes the jitter through the MVs, which DLSS demonstrably consumes. Use with Jitter Color = On, Jitter Depth = Off, Report = 1x.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Report-Only Jitter (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: DEFINITIVE A/B of whether DLSS consumes the reported jitter offset: renders the frame UNJITTERED but still reports the Halton jitter to DLSS. If the image changes vs plain jitter-off, DLSS uses the offset; if it looks identical, DLSS ignores the reported offset entirely. Log shows px=0 (rendered) vs jpx!=0 (reported).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Jitter Test (8px)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Applies a fixed 8px viewport shift. With DLAA OFF + Jitter ON, the whole image must visibly jump 8px (real rasterization shift) to confirm viewport jitter works.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Jitter Method
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Per VS: jitter is added inside each replaced scene-geometry vertex shader (each new scene's VS permutations must be patched). Global: the shared camera ViewProjection in _Globals is patched once, jittering every scene object regardless of VS hash (no per-scene shader gathering).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Zero Motion Vectors
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Forces all motion vectors to 0. A/B: if image looks similar, MVs aren't helping; if worse, MVs contribute useful info.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: MV Direction Flip
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Flips motion vector sign (previous-current instead of current-previous). A/B: if flipping fixes ghosting, the convention was wrong.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: MV Threshold (px)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Zeros CAMERA motion vectors below this magnitude. Kills static sub-pixel MV noise that poisons history. Per-object / Prev-Bone MVs have their own threshold: DLAAPerObjectMVThreshold.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Per-Object MV Threshold (px)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Zeros PER-OBJECT / Prev-Bone motion vectors below this magnitude (dynamic objects: character limbs, hair, etc.). The camera path keeps its own DLAAMVThreshold. Leave 0 to keep all per-object MVs (including small noise).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: 32-bit Motion Vectors
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: MV texture precision A/B: r16g16_float (16-bit, default) vs r32g32_float (32-bit). 32-bit costs a little bandwidth; 16-bit is already exact for pixel-space MVs up to 2048px.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Exclude Effects from DLAA
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Masks particles/effects out of DLAA: they get an off-screen motion vector so DLSS falls back to the current frame (no temporal shimmer/ghosting).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Depth Source
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Which pass's depth DLAA uses. Auto = last full-res depth push (may be wrong). Pick the one that shows a real depth map in MV Debug=Depth. See scan log.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Force Reset (No History)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Forces NGX InReset=1 every frame (no temporal accumulation). A/B test: if identical to Off, history is already disabled.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Per-Object Motion
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Camera Only: camera reprojection MVs only. Per-Object: patched char VSs emit prevClip (current-pose re-skin -> camera-relative MVs). Prev-Bone: patched char VSs re-skin with the PREVIOUS frame's per-character bone matrices -> true limb/animation MVs. Requires Phase B bind mode (NoBind/Minimal off) and a restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Sample Depth Unjittered (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: A/B: sample the velocity camera path's depth at the UNJITTERED pixel (curPxU) instead of the jittered pixel (pix). With an unjittered depth buffer, depth[pix] belongs to content at unjittered position pix, not at curPxU = pix - jitterPx — sampling at pix misreads the depth by up to half a pixel whenever jitter is on, injecting a per-frame MV error DLSS can't compensate (shimmer, worst at 30 FPS). On = sample at curPxU.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Synthetic Jitter MV (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: ESTABLISH THE SIGN: bypasses depth reprojection and writes an ANALYTIC global MV (no DLSS, no depth, no matrices) so the reproj debug view proves the correct jitter-delta MV + sign. At 30 FPS static + jitter ON, whichever of Jcur-Jprev / Jprev-Jcur makes the reproj view BLACK is the sign DLSS needs (then feed it via JitterInMV + report 0).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: HDR Decode (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: HDR-mod compatibility A/B (COMPOSITE path only): converts the DLSS input/output color encoding. Off = feed DLSS the composite as-is. sRGB = decode composite sRGB->linear before DLSS and re-encode the DLSS output linear->sRGB. PQ = same with ST.2084 PQ. The Pre-ToneMap inject path (DLAAHdrInject) does NOT use this.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: HDR Pre-ToneMap Inject
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Where DLAA runs the DLSS pass. Auto: runs at the final_blending draw (raw untonemapped scene) when the HDR mod (_renodx-senkiseki.addon64) is loaded, so the HDR mod tone maps the DLAA'd image itself. Pre-ToneMap: force that path. Composite: run DLSS on the tone-mapped composite at FXAA (old path — SDR-capped with the HDR mod).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: HDR: Float DLSS Output
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Makes the DLSS output texture r16g16b16a16_float instead of r8g8b8a8. The 8-bit UNORM output clamps highlight values before the HDR mod's tone map can recover them (clipping/banding on the Pre-ToneMap path). Float preserves the range through the tone map. Recreates the DLSS feature once on toggle.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase 0 Probe Logging
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Prev-pose feasibility probe (bone-buffer SRV pushes at vertex t0, per-object VS skinned/world detection, buffer handle reuse, and vertex-buffer BindFlags to detect GPU-skinned UAV buffers for the Luma-style prev-vertex capture). Kept SEPARATE from Debug Logging so bone logs aren't buried in general spam.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Generic VS Patch
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Generic DXBC patcher: adds prev-bone re-skin + prevVP to every skinned VS at pipeline creation (per-object motion MVs without per-shader HLSL).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Jitter-Only
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CAMERA PATH (default ON): the generic VS patch injects ONLY the SV_Position camera jitter (b13) — no prevClip output, no prev-bone re-skin, no prevVP, no outline, no OSGN append. Under the GLOBAL jitter method the b13 offset is 0, so this is an inert safety patch. Turn OFF to restore the per-object motion machinery. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Outline Offset
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Replicate the GameEdgeParameters outline offset in the patched prevClip. Now gated on ACTUAL shader usage (most char VSs declare it but never read it, so this is normally a no-op) — only genuinely-outlined shaders get the offset.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Freeze Jitter
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: DIAGNOSTIC: replace the Halton sequence with a CONSTANT sub-pixel jitter (+0.25/-0.25px) every frame. If the Prev-Bone shake disappears with a fixed jitter, the error is the frame-to-frame jitter VARIATION (compensation/timing mismatch), not the MVs themselves.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Freeze Report (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: A/B: render the NORMAL (Halton) jitter but report a CONSTANT jitter to DLSS. If the shake DISAPPEARS, DLSS was reacting to the VARYING report (so the offset we feed is wrong); if it STILL shakes, DLSS ignores the report and the RENDERED variation is the culprit.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Freeze Render (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: A/B (mirror of Freeze Report): render a CONSTANT jitter but report the normal (Halton) jitter. If it SHAKES, DLSS consumes the report; if it STAYS STABLE, DLSS ignores it.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: MV Jitter Comp
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: DIAGNOSTIC: per-object jitter subtraction in the velocity shader A/B (Test A/B with MVJittered off). Off: if the character STOPS shaking, the character was never jittered (we were over-subtracting); if it still shakes, the character IS jittered and compensation isn't the cause.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: MVJittered=1 (Test C)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: DIAGNOSTIC (Test C): feed JITTERED MVs and set MVJittered=1 so DLSS removes the jitter internally (instead of subtracting in the shader). The camera path then ADDS the jitter to stay consistent. Use with Phase: MV Jitter Comp = Off.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Jitter Depth (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: A/B: jitter the DEPTH pass too, so DLSS's color and depth are in the SAME jitter state (Test B). Off (default) = depth stays the game's native UNJITTERED depth (Test A). On = the world + character depth passes are jittered with the color. Only the shadow VS stays unjittered. Watch for the character shadow moving.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase: Jitter Color (diag)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: A/B: master color-jitter toggle. On (default) = color rendered with the jittered VP (normal DLAA). Off = color renders UNJITTERED and 0 jitter is reported to DLSS — the clean baseline (unjittered color + unjittered depth + report 0).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B No-Bind (Game t0/b0 Only)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: patch the VS to read ONLY the game's own t0 bones and b0 ViewProjection, so the patched draw needs NO addon t#/b# bindings (no leak, no extra SRV/CB read). prevClip == current clip (motion ~0) — correct smoke-test baseline. Requires restart to take effect (D3D11 pipeline cache).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Minimal (No Reads)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION (purest): the injected block reads NO resources at all — prevClip = the game's own b0 ViewProjection x float4(v0,1), no re-skin, no outline. Isolates the output register / OSGN / dcl_temps machinery from every new resource read. Requires restart (D3D11 pipeline cache).

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B No Output Register
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: the injected block runs (reads v0 + cb0[10..13]) but adds NO prevClip output register — the PS's v7 goes undefined again. If the crash STOPS, the extra output register / OSGN append is the cause. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Constant Output
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: minimal, but the new output register is written with a CONSTANT (0,0,0,1) — zero reads at all. If it still crashes, the mere existence of the output register faults; if it doesn't, the cb0 read / v7 data matters. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase E Constant Output
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: Phase E adds ONLY the o3 output register, written with a CONSTANT (0.5,0.5,0,1) — no new input decl, no SV_SampleIndex relocation, no vN read. If it still hangs, the mere appended output register faults; if not, the input/relocation/read matters. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase E No Input Read
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: normal input decl + SV relocation, but the injected body writes a CONSTANT — never reads vN. Isolates the vN data path from the declaration/relocation machinery. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase E No Math
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: normal input decl + SV relocation, body = mov o3, vN straight through (no max/div/mad). Isolates the divide/mad math from the read. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase E No New Output (o2.zw)
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: CRASH BISECTION: full input decl + SV relocation + full div/mad math, but prevNDC is written into the EXISTING max output's .zw (o2.zw for 3-RT) instead of appending a NEW SV_TARGET output — NO OSGN append, NO dcl_output. Every crashing test so far appended a new output; if this is safe, the appended output register was the trigger. Requires restart.

senkiseki-dlaa.label: Phase B Evidence Dump
senkiseki-dlaa.tooltip: Write every patched VS's original + patched bytecode (0x<hash>.cso / 0x<new>.patched.cso) and a per-draw crash trace (drawtrace.log) to renodx-dev/dump/phaseb/. The LAST drawtrace line before a GPU TDR identifies the crashing draw.
